main_text.head: ΘΕΟΦΡΑΣΤ καὶ χαρα THEOPHRA racteres sine Morum defc
ISAACO CA INTERP
main_text.p: ÆPE equidem iam ante quum hac de re atten-tius cogitare coepissem, miratus sum: sed nec mirari fortasse desinā, quid causę sit cur quum Graecia omnis eidem caelo subiecta sit, quum etiam Graeci omnes co-dem[?] modo instituantur, non omnes tamen iisdem moribus

ΔΗ μὲν ἐω̂ πεσπεσὸν πολ-λάκις ἐπισή-σας τῷ Δήμοιαν, ἐ-θαύμασα, ἴσως ἢ ἐδὲ παύσομαι θαυμά-ζων, π δήποτε τῆς Ἑλ-λάδος ὑπὸ τὸν αὑτὸν ἀέρα κειμένης, ἢ πάν-των τῶν Ἑλλήνων ὁ-μοίως παιδευομένων, συμξέξηνεν ἡμῖν ἐ-τῷ αὐτῷ τάξιν τῶν

page.notes: Small marks at the left edge beside "Graecia" look like a possible marginal reference sign ("&"), but they are too faint to read with confidence, so I left them out. The reading "co-dem" at the line end is doubtful; the first syllable may be "eo-". The Greek title letters and the italic line "sine" are read from the scan as printed. The left part of every line is cut off, so the title lines and the opening Greek are only partly visible. A small reference mark stands at the left of the line beginning "ἀέρα"; the margin note it points to is not visible. The Greek at the start of the paragraph and the Latin in the title lines are partly illegible; words I could not settle are left as read, without [?] where the scan is too cut to judge. The Δήμοιαν and συμξέξηνεν readings are doubtful.
